transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Tuesday, August 11. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'Fed up of wife's affair', Bengaluru man kills two daughters, attempts suicide. A father allegedly strangled his two young daughters to death in a Bengaluru hotel. He was later found unconscious with his throat slit, attempting suicide. Hotel staff discovered the tragic scene after receiving no response from the room. A death note found at the scene cited marital issues as the motive. 'Unfortunate': Tiger Shroff won't play for Mumbai FC in Durand Cup; here's why. Shroff was included in Mumbai FC's squad for the tournament on July 28, leading to speculation that he could make his competitive debut for the club. However, he confirmed that a last-minute work commitment will prevent him from travelling to Shillong for Mumbai FC's next match. Mark Zuckerberg's $300m yacht booed over rescue call; clarification issued. In a surprising turn of events, Mark Zuckerberg's opulent yacht, Launchpad, faced backlash for not helping a stranded vessel within reach. Crew members clarified that they were on a different radio frequency and claimed assistance was imminent. A cruise ship later intervened, safely bringing the disabled boat back to Farragut Bay. Passengers on the cruise ship expressed their discontent by booing the yacht, which was positioned nearer to the emergency. Trump admin has revoked over 1,75,000 visas since Jan 2025: Who is being targeted. The US State Department Monday published the exact number of visas revoked in the second term of Donald Trump's presidency so far, while the crackdown is going on. Jeff Bezos' ex-wife MacKenzie Scott returns to writing with 80K-word novel. Novelist MacKenzie Scott returns to fiction writing after a thirteen-year hiatus. She will serially release an eighty-thousand-word novel throughout the month of August. Scott studied creative writing under Nobel laureate Toni Morrison at Princeton University. She has given away over twenty-six billion dollars to numerous charitable organizations. Government offers Amit Shah statement in Parliament, opposition doesn't relent. NEW DELHI: Government Monday agreed to a debate in Parliament on the recent student protest and home minister Amit Shah's statement on the issue, but it failed to break the impasse as Congress insisted that all its demands, including PM Modi's apology for alleged police excesses against protesters and a statement on embezzlement of Ram temple funds, be met. Hoover Dam submerged a town in 1935; Lake Mead is revealing it again. The receding waters of Lake Mead have unveiled the eerie remnants of St. Thomas, a ghost town in Nevada. Originally a thriving Mormon settlement founded in 1865, it was swallowed by rising waters after the Hoover Dam was built in 1938. Now, the lakebed displays its foundations, allowing history enthusiasts a rare opportunity to connect with a bygone era of agricultural significance. Missouri plant turns old wind turbine blades into cement feedstock. Repurposing decommissioned wind turbine blades is becoming a promising trend, moving away from traditional landfill disposal. These large fiberglass structures are now being shredded and incorporated into cement production. Furthermore, innovative designs have led to the transformation of some blades into pedestrian bridges. While these initiatives are commendable, they signal just the beginning. Google Drive ends Photos backups starting August 10: What users need to do. Starting August 10, 2026, the Google Drive desktop app will no longer support backups for Google Photos. Users are required to switch to the Google Photos app to continue folder backups smoothly. Thankfully, existing photos will remain intact and secure. However, to enable new automatic backups, users must adjust their settings, as this change affects only computer folder backups, leaving phone backups unaffected. Jharkhand protest: Police defend 'mild force', to scan CCTV for miscreants. NEW DELHI: Police will examine CCTV footage to identify people they allege disrupted a largely peaceful student protest in Ranchi on Monday, as top officials defended the use of "mild" and "minimum" force to disperse job aspirants marching towards the Jharkhand Assembly. 'Compulsive addiction to sanctions': Iran mocks Trump admin's 'suffocating' threat. Iran late Monday mocked the Trump administration's reliance on economic sanctions, warning that Washington's repeated attempts to squeeze Tehran are less a strategy than an "addiction" that could ultimately leave the US with fewer options to end the crisis.

transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Retired IAS Officer Kavindra Kiyawat Questions Promotion Process Of Dy Collector. Madhya Pradesh is set to receive an Airbus ACH 160 helicopter in November, with two state pilots travelling to France for training. Commerce Students Form Nearly Half Of IIM Indore's New IPM Batch. IIM Indore's new 156-member IPM 2026–31 batch includes 75 Commerce students, making up 48.1 percent of the cohort. Heavy rains bring monsoon turnaround to MP, Bhopal goes from deficit to surplus. Woman Loses rupees 10.08 Lakh In Fake Part-Time Job Scam In Indore. A woman in Indore lost rupees 10.08 lakh after fraudsters lured her with a fake part-time job advertised on Instagram. Ujjain received 44 mm rainfall in 24 hours till Monday evening, taking the season's tally to 579 mm, or 23 inches. BRICS countries adopt Bhopal Declaration on Cultural Cooperation. Appointment of 30 Judges for High Courts of Madras, Calcutta, Madhya Pradesh and Karnataka notified. Madhya Pradesh gets four new flight routes, Bhopal, Rewa, Jabalpur linked to Patna, Kolkata. Rain bares civic cracks, leaves city's old and new areas marooned. Patna gets first direct flight link with Bhopal. Para National Kayaking Championship postponed as Lower Lake swells after deluge. transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Traders Are Piling Into Taiwan Dollar Options to Bet on Rebound. Currency traders are stepping up bullish options bets on the Taiwan dollar, signaling a shift in sentiment after the currency suffered its worst July since 2015. CDs' share in debt fund portfolio surges ahead of g-sec. Bank certificates of deposit became the largest holding in debt mutual funds in FY26, overtaking government securities as taxation changes shifted investor preference towards shorter-duration schemes Europe Gas Prices Surge as Hormuz Deal Prospects Remain Murky. European natural gas prices jumped as discussions between Iran and Oman to reopen the Strait of Hormuz failed to convince traders that a deal would lead to a quick resumption of global LNG flows. ABSL MF launches 2 SIFs; Dhoot Transmission IPO booked 63 percent on Day 1. Apex Equity Long Short Fund seeks to offer diversified exposure across the equity market with the flexibility to dynamically adjust net equity exposure Wheat Climbs With USDA Seen Tightening Global Grain Supply. Wheat was higher as traders braced for the US Department of Agriculture's monthly supply demand report that's expected to show declining domestic and world grain supplies. Milky Mist Dairy Food raises rupees 465 cr from 19 anchor investors ahead of IPO. Anchor book draws Temasek subsidiary Zulia Investments, IFC and domestic mutual funds as the dairy company prepares to tap the public market Yen Weakens 1 percent , Erases Half of US-Japan Intervention Gains. The yen extended its losses, erasing half of the gains triggered when authorities from the US and Japan intervened in the foreign-exchange market to support the currency. BSE to replace Wipro in Nifty 50 index from Sep 30 after semi-annual review. BSE's inclusion follows NSE Indices' semi-annual review and is based on its higher six-month average free-float market capitalisation compared with Wipro Gold climbs to nine-week high on buying momentum as inflation data looms. GLOBAL-PRECIOUS/ (UPDATE 8):PRECIOUS-Gold climbs to nine-week high on buying momentum as inflation data looms Mandatory hallmarking of gold jewellery expanded to 392 districts. Mandatory hallmarking for gold jewellery and artefacts has been expanded to 392 districts, adding 12 districts across nine states to the BIS framework Wall Street eases as hopes for imminent Hormuz deal fade; Intel drops. USA-STOCKS/ (UPDATE 5):US STOCKS-Wall Street eases as hopes for imminent Hormuz deal fade; Intel drops Paytm shares jump 10 percent after Bernstein revises target price to rupees 2,200. Paytm shares surged 10 percent after Bernstein raised its target price to rupees 2,200, citing potential UPI merchant discount rates that could lift the fintech's payments margins from FY28 Zen Technologies shares to be in focus on Tuesday after company secures rupees 295 crore defence order. Zen Technologies secured a rupees 295 crore order from the Ministry of Defence for simulators, enhancing its order pipeline, which totals rupees 1,239.02 crore. The revenue outlook is positive as new products and Air Force training offerings are in development, despite a decline in profits this quarter. Sebi proposes raising annual ISIN limit for private debt securities to 17. The existing framework allows a maximum of 14 ISINs maturing in a financial year - nine for plain-vanilla debt and five for structured and market-linked debt securities Intel plans $15 billion share sale as turnaround rally lifts stock. Intel is investing heavily in new facilities and advanced packaging capabilities as it seeks to challenge industry leaders such as TSMC in contract chip manufacturing Indian envoys meet Nepal, Bangladesh PMs. Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah met Indian envoy Naveen Srivastav, ending his ban on individual foreign envoy meetings. This new-age tech stock hits over 4-year high, recovers 70 percent from March lows. Are you holding it?. One97 Communications, parent of Paytm, saw a 10 percent share increase to rupees 1,598 after Bernstein raised its target price to rupees 2,200, citing potential UPI fee benefits. Capria Ventures' Will Poole joins board of CMS Info Systems. CMS Info Systems (CMS) announced the appointment of William Poole VIII (Will Poole) as Additional Director (Independent). CMS runs an integrated platform spanning ATM management, retail and currency logistics, and technology and payments. Will brings to CMS's board four decades of building and scaling technology businesses, as a senior executive at Microsoft and most recently as a venture investor across emerging markets. His appointment comes as CMS accelerates its investments in Vision AI, data and automation. Plea received to waive airline cross-holding rules. The government said AAI has received a request to waive airport-airline cross-holding restrictions, though the civil aviation ministry has yet to examine it. Nippon India Equity buys stake in Iris Clothings that has risen 250 percent in five years. The company's shares have maintained a strong winning run for over a year, hitting record highs repeatedly and ending several months with gains. The sustained rally has turned the stock into one of the biggest wealth creators. Royal Jordanian Airlines selects Ramco's next-gen aviation software. Ramco Systems FZ - LLC, a subsidiary of Ramco Systems, announced that Royal Jordanian Airlines, the National carrier of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, has selected Ramco's next-generation Aviation Software to support its next phase of growth, following a comprehensive evaluation of global aviation software solutions. Gaza Board of Peace member says plan still operative. A US official stated the Gaza plan remains operative and advancing. Wall Street slips ahead of inflation data, crude oil surges. As of 12:43 p.m. Eastern Time, the S and P 500 fell 0.1 percent , the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.2 percent , and the Nasdaq Composite was 0.5 percent lower. Sebi proposes easing debt listing norms, raising ISIN maturity limits. Sebi has proposed scrapping mandatory listing of past debt issues and raising the annual ISIN cap to 17, aiming to ease funding constraints and reduce refinancing risks for issuers Students, police clash in Jharkhand. Protesting students marched towards the Jharkhand assembly after inconclusive government talks. Vodafone Idea Q1 Results: Net loss narrows to rupees 3,754 crore, ARPU rises to rupees 195; key highlights. Vodafone Idea reported a net loss of rupees 3,754 crore for the June quarter, improving from a loss of rupees 6,608 crore a year ago. The consolidated revenue rose to rupees 11,689 crore, a 2.4 percent increase from rupees 11,023 crore in June 2025. Bajel Projects bags two transmission projects. transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Sold property for rupees 94 lakh despite a stamp value of rupees 1.93 crore, received an income tax notice under Section 50C; ITAT Chennai grants relief for this reason. Chennai man sold property for rupees 94 lakh despite rupees 1.93 crore stamp duty value; so tax dept sent notice u/s Section 50C to tax the differential amount; ITAT Chennai gives him relief; Know why he won the case in ITAT Chennai. Top 5 small-cap funds can take 28 days longer than mid-caps to sell half of their portfolios: Experts discuss risks. SEBI's FY26 data shows top five small-cap funds take 51 days to liquidate half their portfolios, versus 23 days for mid-caps. Experts say lower small-cap liquidity and rising AUM can increase redemption risks, making stress-test trends worth monitoring. Indian investors are looking beyond domestic markets, with overseas equities and crypto both seeing strong participation. The data reveals that investors are using both as part of a broader diversification strategy. Parents wins back their flat gifted to son as tribunal finds son failed to take care of parents; Bombay HC orders son to vacate the property. Son promised to care for elderly parents after receiving their Mumbai flat as gift; however, he failed to do so; Bombay High Court cancels gift deed and orders son and wife to vacate. Know why son lost the case in Bombay High Court. 8th Pay Commission: Government gives status report in Lok Sabha; what employees should know. The government said the 8th Pay Commission was given 18 months from the date of its constitution to submit its report. Here's who could benefit and what remains undecided on salaries and pensions. Is UPI ending free payments for all users? Here's what Finance Ministry says. Standard UPI transfers for individuals will remain complimentary, ensuring users can continue making everyday payments without worry. While most merchant transactions also stay free, high-value business dealings may bear small fees. Not all multi-asset allocation funds are alike: Only one scheme is rated low risk , why others are red-flagged. Multi-asset allocation funds may look similar, but their risk profiles can be poles apart. Of the 34 schemes, only one carries a Low risk rating, while five are rated High risk. The portfolio mix offers some clues. Sold land for rupees 7.24 crore, paid no tax, received income tax notice; Know how Google Earth photos and revenue records helped taxpayer to win this case in ITAT Ahmedabad. Family member sold his 1/3rd share of agricultural land for rupees 7.24 crore, pays no tax, tax dept sent notice, he wins case in ITAT Ahmedabad; Know how Google earth photos and Revenue Records helped him win. Read the article. Repo rate stays at 5.25 percent : Why your home loan EMI may still change in 2026 and what historical data shows. Even if the RBI keeps the repo rate unchanged at 5.25 percent in 2026, your home loan EMI may not stay the same. MCLR-linked loans can move independently, while even repo-linked loans may see changes. Historical data reveals an uneven link between the MCLR and policy rate. REIT, InvIT dividend tax relief may boost investor returns; know who benefits and what remains taxable. The proposed tax change could make REIT and InvIT dividends tax-free for investors regardless of the tax regime chosen by the underlying SPV. However, interest and other components of distributions will remain taxable, so investors must check the payout breakup before calculating post-tax returns. Ladli Behna Yojana MP: 39th instalment of rupees 1,500 may arrive early as Raksha Bandhan gift. The Ladli Behna Yojana serves as a crucial pillar for economic empowerment, supplying eligible women across Madhya Pradesh with direct financial assistance of rupees 1,500 every month. Received an income tax notice? Here's why you should authenticate it and how to do it online. Filed ITR for AY 2026-27 and received an income tax notice? Before responding, taxpayers can authenticate it online to check whether it was genuinely issued by the department. Here's how the DIN and OTP-based verification can help you spot fake notices. Why you may lose EPF interest on your inoperative account: EPFO explains what you should do. Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) accounts become inactive if there are no contributions or withdrawals for three consecutive years. To avoid losing interest, it's recommended that early retirees withdraw their funds before this age. EPFO encourages members to manage their balances proactively to maintain interest accumulation and avert potential financial setbacks. Will you be charged for UPI peer transfers, grocery payments? MyGovIndia busts myths on MDR; here's what stays free. Viral claims suggest UPI payments could soon become chargeable after a recent PSS Act amendment. MyGovIndia has clarified that routine personal UPI transfers remain free. Here are the key myths and facts every UPI user should be aware of. EPFO Security Alert: 5 things EPF members must know to protect their account from online fraud. The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has warned EPF members to be careful while accessing their accounts online, especially as fake websites and phishing messages can be used to steal personal and financial information. 8th Pay Commission news: Minimum salary of rupees 69,000 and minimum pension of rupees 45,000; what Bharat Pension Samaj recommended to 8th CPC. 8th Pay Commission fitment factor: Bharat Pensioners Samaj met 8th Pay Commission officials proposing a minimum pension of rupees 45,000. They also recommended a minimum basic salary of rupees 69,000 for central government employees. The delegation suggested revising pay and pension every five years instead of ten. They also asked for quarterly revision of Dearness Allowance and Dearness Relief. Capital Gains Tax: How stocks, ETFs and equity mutual funds are taxed now. For equity mutual funds, exchange-traded funds and stocks, the holding period required to qualify as a long-term investment is more than 12 months. STCG on these assets is taxed at 20 percent , while LTCG is taxed at 12.5 percent on gains exceeding the applicable annual exemption threshold. Closing a credit card with outstanding EMI? Experts explain hidden charges and rules. Cancelling a credit card with an outstanding EMI does not erase repayment obligations. Know what happens to EMIs, foreclosure charges, pending dues and credit scores before closing your card. Daughter sues father for withdrawing money from her PPF account, Delhi High Court orders return of entire corpus. A daughter sued her father for withdrawing money from her PPF account. The Delhi High Court ruled that a father cannot withdraw funds from his daughter's PPF account for maintenance payments. Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund July portfolio: CIE Automotive, Petronet LNG see higher holdings; check top 10 stocks. Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund increased holdings in 11 existing stocks in July, with Petronet LNG, CIE Automotive and gas companies among the biggest additions. The fund made no fresh equity additions or complete exits, while its cash allocation declined from 12.72 percent in June to 11.74 percent in July. Financial wellbeing at workplace: Planning for retirement, child's education still top challenge for employees; here's how it can change. Financial action is moving faster than financial preparedness among employees, with many investing, exploring new opportunities, and thinking about long-term goals, but still seeking clarity on fundamentals. A survey by financial education firm Finsafe sheds light on this paradox and the role employers can play. Indian students in the US can invest in stocks, but FEMA and tax rules matter. Here's what to know. Indian students studying in the US can invest in both Indian and US stocks, but their investment options and tax obligations depend on FEMA status, Indian tax residency, US tax residency, source of funds, and applicable reporting and withholding rules. 8th Pay Commission salary calculator: How a 6 percent annual increment could boost Level 10 and 12 pay. Employee and pensioner groups have urged the 8th Pay Commission to raise the annual increment rate from the current 3 percent to 5–7 percent . Want to achieve financial freedom?
